missing: Measured results on an actual M4 iPad Pro using all three at once: whether the hub keeps charging (real watts delivered) while it drives a 4K60 monitor and an SSD, and what SSD speeds it gets in that setup, plus current prices.
why: Macworld is a major reviewer with an iPad-specific hub guide that lists passthrough wattage and 4K60, so it partly answers the question. It doesn't cover the M4's faster USB4 port or test an SSD alongside a monitor while charging. Engadget's tested guide is about hubs in general. Apple's page doesn't name any hubs. The rest are off-target TechRadar and Tom's Guide pages, a hub maker's blog, an affiliate listicle and one niche site whose testing can't be checked. A focused page testing all three loads together could get in, but it would compete with Macworld.
